sn20.11:1.2: assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ sigālassa vassamānassāti.
sn20.11:1.4: eso kho bhikkhave jarasigālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho.
sn20.11:1.5: so yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati
sn20.11:1.6: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati
sn20.11:1.7: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nisīdati
sn20.11:1.8: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nipajjati.
sn20.11:1.10: sādhu khvassa bhikkhave yaṃ idhekacco sakyaputtiyapaṭiñño evarūpampi attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyeva.
